meaning: All mathematical subsets absent from every audited trigger output.
proof_required: Recompute all finite trigger outputs and prove the subset key is absent; report the rule-level complement count, not a historical claim.
reopening_condition: A new source pattern or gap finding invalidates this exclusion until regeneration.

meaning: Search result, title, abstract index, keyword, citation, or database metadata without a reviewable evidence locator.
proof_required: Record query/result identity and absence of qualifying locator-bearing review.
reopening_condition: A later reviewed source may generate a new candidate.

meaning: Terms are present but do not participate in one bounded configuration.
proof_required: Record locus and reviewer reason distinguishing presence from participation.
reopening_condition: Direct group evidence reopens the structure.

meaning: A source supports concept eligibility but explicitly does not support an association.
proof_required: Preserve source scope note and forbid association activation.
reopening_condition: Separate association evidence may create a candidate.

meaning: Evidence crosses incompatible time, place, institution, actor, case, mechanism, or bounded sense.
proof_required: Record each conflicting dimension and source locator.
reopening_condition: Only a newly bounded compatible candidate may proceed.

meaning: A connected graph or composition exists only because pair edges compose.
proof_required: Link all pair records and the missing global review gate.
reopening_condition: Completed group review replaces this class with a substantive disposition.

meaning: Proposed order, role, direction, or render topology exceeds the evidence.
proof_required: Record supported semantics separately from rejected realization.
reopening_condition: A corrected realization requires a distinct reviewed mapping.

meaning: At least one label lacks a governed bounded sense.
proof_required: Link the gap or vocabulary decision.
reopening_condition: A later governed sense decision may trigger review.

meaning: The item is a context, condition, or analytic annotation rather than a participating association member.
reopening_condition: A different bounded sense requires a new authority decision.

meaning: A label is an alias or merged vocabulary identity.
proof_required: Canonicalize to the governed vocabulary/sense ID and prove no semantic distinction remains.
reopening_condition: A newly governed distinct sense creates a new identity.

meaning: Evidence cannot be lawfully or reliably reviewed at a stable locator.
proof_required: Record access condition, attempt, and non-retention decision.
reopening_condition: Legitimate later access may reopen review; never activate while blocked.

meaning: Shared product category, archive folder, similarity edge, or database join lacks group evidence.
proof_required: Record the mechanical discovery path and absence of historical support.
reopening_condition: Reviewable same-case evidence may create a candidate.

meaning: An exact canonical candidate identity already exists.
proof_required: Link the surviving ID and canonical identity hash.
reopening_condition: Different role, order, scope, case, or authority prevents this exclusion.

meaning: The structure does not concern governed Exploration vocabulary associations or their product realizations.
proof_required: State the governing boundary without evaluating the historical claim.
reopening_condition: A changed authority requires a new round or explicit authorization.
